submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No submissions} one {1 submission} other {# submissions}} loaded

no_contact_point.what: The visitor gave no usable email or phone, so no contact could be made.
no_contact_point.todo: Open the answers, add the missing detail to the contact by hand, or fix the form's mapping and retry.

invalid_phone.what: The phone number could not be read as a valid number.
invalid_phone.todo: Open the answers, check the number, then retry once the form accepts it or add the contact by hand.

plan_limit_reached.what: Your plan's contact limit was reached, so a new contact was not created.
plan_limit_reached.todo: Free up contacts or upgrade your plan, then retry.

submissions_cap.what: Your plan's monthly submission limit was reached, so this was saved for review.
submissions_cap.todo: Upgrade your plan or wait for the next month, then retry.

spam_score.what: The submission looked like spam and was set aside.
spam_score.todo: If it is a real person, open it and add them as a contact by hand.

too_fast.what: It was sent faster than a person can fill the form, so it was set aside as spam.
too_fast.todo: If it is a real person, open it and add them as a contact by hand.

internal_error.what: Something went wrong on our side while handling it. The answers are kept.
internal_error.todo: Retry it. If it fails again, contact support with the submission time.

unknown.what: This submission is set aside for a reason this version of the app does not recognise.
unknown.todo: Open it to see the details, then retry or handle it by hand.

drawer.title: Submission from {who}
drawer.errorTitle: This submission could not be opened.
drawer.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
drawer.auditNote: Opening a submission's answers is recorded in the audit log.
drawer.removedBody: The answers were erased or purged. Only this record remains, and the contact was kept.
drawer.noConsent: This form did not ask for consent.
drawer.ageUnder: Under the minimum age. The submission was accepted and the contact was flagged as a minor; marketing consent was not recorded.
drawer.guardianNote: Given by the visitor, not checked. Their consent is not on record until a person records it on the contact's Consent card.

actions.exportHintAttention: Pick a single status to export from this group, or use All.
actions.exportHintSearch: The export ignores the search text.

confirmDelete.title: Delete these answers?
confirmDelete.message: This erases the answers of this submission for good. A row stays in the list as a record that it happened, and the contact is never deleted.

toast.notRetryable: Only submissions that need review or failed can be retried.
toast.purged: The answers were already removed, so there is nothing to retry.
toast.retryFailed: The retry did not go through. Please try again.
toast.deleted: The answers were deleted. The contact was kept.
toast.deleteFailed: The answers could not be deleted. Please try again.
toast.exportTruncated: The export was cut at the newest {max} rows. Narrow the dates to get the rest.
toast.exportFailed: The export could not be made. Please try again.
toast.linkReady: A new payment link is ready.
toast.linkFailed: The gateway did not give a link. Try again in a moment.
toast.markPaidFailed: Could not mark this submission as paid.

state.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
state.lockedTitle: Forms is not part of your plan
state.lockedBody: Add the Forms app to your workspace to collect and review submissions.
state.emptyBody: Share the form's link or embed it on your site. Every submission appears here as soon as someone sends it.
state.emptyFilteredBody: Nothing fits these filters. Clear them to see everything.

cap.notice: Some submissions were saved for review because your plan's monthly submission limit was reached.

payments.title: Payment
payments.duplicate: A second payment arrived for this submission. Refund it from your payment gateway.
payments.freshLink: New payment link (send it to the visitor):
payments.markPaidConfirm: Mark this submission as paid? Use this only when the money arrived outside the gateway, such as a bank transfer or cash. It is recorded under your name.
